description.zh-CN: 雾中远山与一叶扁舟。散落的文件化作纸笺飞入书卷，收工即是掩灯，灯油就是电量。
description.en: Misty ink mountains and a lone boat. Loose files fly into a scroll as paper slips; winding down puts out the lamp, and the lamp oil is your battery.

concept.world: A scholar's study at the edge of misty mountains: xuan paper, ink, a vermilion seal and an oil lamp.
concept.mood: Quiet and unhurried. Light ink on warm paper by day, pale ink on deep paper at night.
concept.type: KaiTi (楷体) set vertically, read right to left, the way the scrolls are.
concept.motion: Mist drifts, a boat crosses over minutes, birds pass rarely. Nothing loops faster than a breath.

metaphors.tidy-files.run: 收卷 Roll up: each filed document flies from the desktop into the scroll as a paper slip
metaphors.tidy-files.undo: 展卷 Unroll: the slips fly back out
metaphors.tidy-files.open: 书阁 The library where the scrolls are kept
metaphors.tidy-files.pending: 散页 Loose pages, counted in Chinese numerals
metaphors.quit-apps.run: 掩灯 Put out the lamp: the day's books close and the scene sinks into deeper ink
metaphors.system.battery: 灯油 Lamp oil, in tenths (八成)
metaphors.weather: A vertical inscription; rain falls as fine ink strokes, snow as paper flecks
metaphors.clock: The double-hour (时辰) and the date written in Chinese numerals
